doc.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019

title: Stump the band improvisation
summary: Chez recalls improvising songs on the spot when the band was asked for a song name.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Okay. And the occasional “Granny in the Basement?”
“Granny in the Cellar.” What was that?

Yeah. That was top of my head. Just kind of yeah, improv it, just kind of improv. And they would come up with a name of a song and you’d be like yeah, I know that song, and you would make up your own song. You know country. [Scats] you know and you’d just come up with some weird lyrics to it. So yeah, that was a lot of fun.
